name: Rizuhble's Unkillable Rat King
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rule, Ratannia! unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice. Ultimate (Rule, Ratannia!) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 6,400 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 6 purchases
items.legacy_note: Your grenade scales with your weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Imbued on Scrap Grenade: widens its range (shrapnel sphere radius).
items.legacy_note: On the grenade.

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Colossus later. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-16,000 (levels 13-22). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Scrap Grenade T3, Royal Pestments T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.why: weapon investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Fleetfoot, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases
items.legacy_note: Your cape barrier grows with your max health.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Scrap Grenade: takes 18% off its 18s base cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On the grenade.

items.name: Return Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Only if they have a real gun hero: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Vyper.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 16,000-44,800 (levels 22-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rule, Ratannia! T3.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 10,400 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 10,400 to 13,600 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage. | Imbued on Scrap Grenade.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: The max health it steals also makes your cape barrier bigger.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 216s; 20% off is 43.2s per full rotation.

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Opening Rounds for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fleetfoot.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fleetfoot.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Bullet Resilience isn't enough.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences that stop your ult.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 19 to 52 spirit power. Imbued on Scrap Grenade: resets its 18s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown.
items.legacy_note: On the grenade. Sell Fleetfoot for this.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 60 to 66 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Cultist Sacrifice for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 19 to 52 spirit power. Resets every ability and charge: up to 216s of base cooldown across your kit, 160s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s.
items.legacy_note: Sell Return Fire for this, or Point Blank if you skipped it.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Enduring Speed.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Superior Cooldown.

sections.legacy_desc: Get Cultist Sacrifice right after Sprint Boots, then carry on.
